entities.summary: Catholic Church, a political institution in Sweden during Vasa Dynasty & Great Power Era (1523–1560). Grew from Gustav Vasa elected King of Sweden, breaking from the Kalmar Union. Led to the emergence of Swedish Reformation and Vasa Sons & Succession Crises.
